description: Shorti(쇼티) for «how do I shoot one like this?» or «나도 이렇게 찍으려면?». One format as a creator shoots it: its plan, its hits, its spread. `how_to_shoot`: its reference hit step by step on that hit's own clock, what its videos keep and what is the person's to change; its strongest hits; where viewers reacted; `flow`, how it moved. By `format_id`, or `video_id`/`url` of one of its videos.

detail.description: summary: the compact answer, prompts for a model marked for_model. full: every field in both languages, paged by `cursor`.

format_id.description: The format's id or its page's slug.

lang.description: 'en' answers in Shorti's own English: never translate its Korean.

url.description: One of its videos, by the post's link.

video_id.description: One of its videos, by Shorti's id.

name: shorti_format

context.description: shorti.context.v1: the hit this answer names by its own measure, its format's rules about it with how many of the format's breakouts keep each, and what each grade means; the answer's text is its brief

flow.description: how its way of shooting moved: the line about now, the ladder of changes, the worlds it moved into, the spots nobody has taken

idea_card.description: the format's own idea card (Shorti's reading)

moments.description: the moments viewers reacted to, each where it shows

refusal.description: why nothing was answered, by name

title: How to shoot a format
